g.text: One system, every process that uses it and in what role, and the capabilities those processes support. This shows the business impact of changing the system. A
long list against a low criticality rating is worth a second look.

g.title: Set deposit rates and product terms
Open and fund direct deposit account
Issue brokered CDs through the broker network
Settle brokered CDs and keep the position
Process CD maturity, renewal, and early withdrawal
Administer deposit insurance records and escheatment
